chunks.title: BBVA Group (BBVA) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: BBVA Group is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in Spain. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official Global Banking Partner of COP31 Antalya; 400m² Green Zone Pavilion with 60+ climate finance sessions. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: €700B sustainable business goal (2025–2029; €170B mobilized by Q1 2026; €36B in Q1 2026 alone) across electrification, cleantech & transition. Source verification: https://www.bbva.com/en/sustainability/bbva-to-be-the-global-banking-partner-of-the-united-nations-climate-summit-cop31-in-turkiye/.

chunks.title: BBVA Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: BBVA Group provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Loan, Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL), Green Bond Underwriting, Project Finance, Cleantech Venture Debt. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Financial Intermediary.

chunks.title: BBVA Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by BBVA Group: Electrification & Grid, Renewable Energy, Climate-Tech Innovation, Industrial Decarbonization, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Nature & Water. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, Türkiye, Latin America, North America, Emerging Markets. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: BBVA Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete BBVA's application form: LMA Green Loan Principles / Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles / ICMA GBP alignment; EU Taxonomy or BBVA Sustainable Finance Framework eligibility; Scope 1/2/3 decarbonization KPIs & transition plan; Credit underwriting & Second-Party Opinion (for labeled bonds/SLLs). Explicit exclusion rules: Thermal coal expansion; Unaligned high-controversy projects. Official application portal: https://www.bbva.com/en/sustainability/.

chunks.title: BBVA Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: BBVA Group uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.
